candidate.title: Explain personal-data collection before collecting it
candidate.type: Narrow statutory privacy information guidance; not a registration or audit-filing rule
candidate.jurisdiction: Nigeria national; assess section2 territorial connection
relevance_facts: Ordinary commercial business purpose, not purely personal/household
No claimed section3 partial exemption requiring separate assessment
candidate.substantive_summary: For in-scope controllers, section27 requires information before direct collection and an accessible privacy policy. It covers identity/contact details, purpose and lawful basis, recipients, rights, retention, complaint route and relevant automated decisions. Indirect-collection exceptions are separately stated in section27(2). GAID Article27 elaborates understandable formats and clarifies that providing information is not itself consent.
actions: Inventory each collection point and purpose
Complete accurate notice fields from actual operations
Provide the notice before collection in understandable accessible form
Request consent separately only where it is the applicable lawful basis
avoid: Do not infer universal NDPC registration, DPO appointment or CAR filing from this candidate
Do not invent fees or a fixed retention duration
Do not treat an accepted privacy notice as consent for all uses
Do not claim the notice alone achieves full compliance
